title: Fix Stacked Tab Active Chrome
description: When two tabs are stacked in mode dock, window chrome breaks: active mark draws across full width, body frame missing. Fix multi-tab ModeDockTabBar/ModeDockStack layout so active primary stroke wraps only active tab+body column.
summary: Stack-active mode dock tab now uses three-sided primary chrome (border-t/l/r, border-b-0) matching inactive siblings; removed !border-r-0 from modeDockActiveTabClass. Extended Mode tab stack test to assert border-r and no border-r-0 on active tab.
